units.source_text: 我的回答是符合惯例的。

en.t: My answer was in keeping with convention.

units.source_text: 也许你会笑我，不过我冲着这个女子回答说："我不爱你。"

en.t: Perhaps you will laugh at me, but I answered this woman directly: "I do not love you."

units.source_text: 除此以外，难道还能有别的回答吗？

en.t: Apart from that, could there really have been any other answer?

units.source_text: 这个回答是诚实的，毫无夸耀的意思。

en.t: That answer was honest, with no intention of boasting at all.

units.source_text: 面对着女子的表白，假使我觉得奇货可居而回答说"我也爱你"，那就未免太滑稽，也近乎悲剧了吧。

en.t: Faced with the woman's confession, if I had treated it as some rare prize and answered, "I love you too," that would have been far too ridiculous, almost tragic.

units.source_text: 一个外形滑稽的男人，是知道采取高明的方法来回送别人错误地把自己看成悲剧的。

en.t: A man who looks ridiculous knows how to use a skillful method to send back the mistaken way others see him as tragic.

units.source_text: 因为他知道，倘使让别人看成悲剧，那么人家就不能放心地与自己交往了。

en.t: For he knows that if others are allowed to see him as tragic, they will no longer be able to associate with him at ease.

units.source_text: 要不让别人把自己看得很凄惨，首先就要为别人的灵魂着想，这是至关重要的。

en.t: In order not to let others see oneself as terribly pitiable, it is crucial first of all to consider their souls.

units.source_text: 因此，我才敢干脆地说："我不爱你！"

en.t: That is why I dared to say plainly: "I do not love you!"
